One limitation of the iPad app is the text size and layout. For many readers, the small screen of the iPad makes it difficult to focus on the wide-ranging and complex structure of the poem. Similarly, the limited capacity of the app to show page breaks and the physicality of the book—elements the traditional reading experience makes available—decreases the significance of the tactile experience of the physical book. Another element of the app that affects the reading experience is its inability to accommodate the varied reading habits of individual users. The app’s tailored format may not be the most effective format for presenting The Waste Land.
